{{Top|leg}}
The '''Argazdan battle fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] established by [[Myrial]], the leader of the [[Vianism|Vianist]] religious sect [[Myrialites]]. The [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] separatist leader formed the fleet to help protect the [[Argazdan Redoubt]]&mdash;claimed territory in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]&mdash;after she declared the secession from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The first target of the battle fleet was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ereesus]], where Myrial ordered the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to scorch the world and eliminate all life there, retaliation for the [[Ereesi/Legends|Ereesi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of the Argazdans before the [[Republic–Ereesi war|war]] that ended the Argazdans' servitude. The massacre on Ereesus marked the beginning of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]].<ref name="EA ">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
